name: Bath with MEW
source:
It's been a long day and you decided to treat yourself to a spa day. All is going well, until your time in the bathhouse is rudely interrupted by a large dragon who refuses to move out of your bath.

Can you convince him to leave, or will his stubbornness prove too strong for you?

[from [url=https://goldieclaws.itch.io/bath-with-mew]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是漫长的一天，你决定犒赏自己一次水疗日。一切都很顺利，直到你在澡堂的时间被一条拒绝离开浴室的巨龙粗鲁地打断。

你能说服他离开吗？还是他的固执对你来说太强大了？

[来自[url=https://goldieclaws.itch.io/bath-with-mew]itch.io[/url]]
